blocks.text: Original document: [docs/camera.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/camera.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
The Retiam Engine now supports advanced cinematic camera models and hybrid rendering (Rasterization + Path Tracing).
Click on the canvas to lock the mouse cursor and enable interactive camera control. Press `ESC` to release the cursor.

children: When `ON`, 3D models will be path-traced using the BVH, providing real-time global illumination, soft shadows, and physically-accurate glass refraction.
When `OFF`, the engine dynamically rebuilds the FrameGraph and instantly switches to the high-speed Rasterizer.

items.text: **M:** Cycle through the 5 available projection models:
children: **360 VR (Raytrace Only):** Equirectangular projection for HDRI/VR rendering.
**2-Point Perspective:** Automatically keeps vertical lines perfectly straight (Architectural photography style), applying tilt-shift mathematically.

items: **[ / ]:** Adjust **Aperture**. Increases/Decreases the Depth of Field (DoF) blur effect. (Raytrace Only).
**Q / E:** Adjust **Focus Distance** manually. Moves the focal plane closer or further away. (Raytrace Only).

**F:** Toggle **Auto Focus**. When turned ON, the camera casts a ray into the scene (using the CPU-side BVH) to automatically detect objects in the center of the screen and smoothly lerp the `focusDist` to them, keeping them perfectly sharp!
**- / =:** Adjust **Orthographic Scale**. Zooms the camera in and out when the `Orthographic` camera model is active.

blocks.text: You can script these parameters directly in your animation sequence using the `Camera` instance:

To eliminate manual camera guesswork and solve AI spatial placement issues, Retiam provides automated bounding-volume framing. The camera computes exact sensor-plane projections and positions itself so that all target entities fit comfortably into view with guaranteed margins.

items: **Perspective Projection**: Solves frustum depth $D = \max(D_h, D_w) + \frac{\text{depth}}{2}$, guaranteeing 3D volumes never clip the near plane.
**Orthographic Projection**: Automatically calculates `orthoScale` to envelope targets across horizontal and vertical aspect ratios.
**Depth of Field Integration**: Automatically aligns `camera.focusDist` with the center of the framed content for sharp focal plane rendering.
**Multi-Entity & Bounding Box Support**: Accepts a single `Entity`, `Entity[]`, `AABB`, or coordinate point array.
**Directional Reorientation**: Optional `direction` parameter to view the framed content from an angle (e.g. `[1, 1, 1]`).
